content: SMAppService (macOS 13+): agent(plistName:) resolves plist only from Contents/Library/LaunchAgents of the main bundle; plist uses BundleProgram relative path; behaves like a launchd agent (RunAtLoad, KeepAlive, MachServices); user approval via System Settings Login Items; Rust bindings objc2-service-management 0.3.x, smappservice-rs wrapper. FDA inheritance for agents is not clearly documented; post-11.4 helpers do not inherit TCC from main app (CVE-2021-30713) - needs spike.
